beats.summary: Dwight explains the Schrutes' practice of ensuring the dead are truly dead to prevent grave robbing.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: We Schrutes don't need some Harvard doctor to tell us who's alive and who's dead.
when grave robbers discovered some scratch marks on the inside of some of the coffins, we decided to make sure that our dead were completely dead.

beats.summary: Office workers debate whether to eat cupcakes from Todd Packer, reflecting their mixed feelings about him.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I don't think we should eat Packers' cupcakes. We can't give him the satisfaction.

beats.summary: Aunt Shirley offers her farm to Dwight, Fannie, and Jeb if they return home, sparking family tension.
Dwight agrees to run Aunt Shirley's farm despite Fannie's objections about farm life lacking sophistication.
